arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/t_input.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from harness import *
failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:200]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:200])
    else: print('ok  ',name)
ERR={"error":"input"}
def doc(**kw):
    base={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    base.update(kw); return json.dumps(base)

for raw in [b'{"seed":"s","seed":"t"}',
            b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[],"channels":[]}',
            b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[{"name":"a","name":"b","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}}],"events":[],"channels":[]}',
            b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h","host":"x"}}],"events":[],"channels":[]}',
            b'\xff\xfe{"seed":"s"}', b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"seed":"s"}', b'{"seed":"s"} {}', b'', b'   ', b'[]', b'"x"', b'1', b'null',
            b'{"seed":"s"}\n\n{"x":1}', b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[],}',
            b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":NaN}', b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":1e999}', b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":Infinity}',
            b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":-Infinity}', b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":1.5e-310}',
            b'{"seed":"\\ud800"}',
            b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"\\ud800"}],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}}],"events":[],"channels":[]}']:
    p = run_raw(raw)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        check('raw '+repr(raw[:24]), 'exit%d'%p.returncode, 'exit0'); continue
    check('raw '+repr(raw[:24]), json.loads(p.stdout.decode()), ERR)

check('bool timeout', run(doc(timeout_ms=True)), ERR)
check('float timeout', run(doc(timeout_ms=1.0)), ERR)
check('string timeout', run(doc(timeout_ms="1")), ERR)
check('zero timeout', run(doc(timeout_ms=0)), ERR)
check('big timeout', run(doc(timeout_ms=1000000001)), ERR)
check('timeout 1e9 ok', run(doc(timeout_ms=1000000000))['cases'], [])
check('unknown root key', json.loads(run_raw(doc(extra=1).encode()).stdout.decode()), ERR)
d = json.loads(doc()); del d['cases']
check('missing root key', run(json.dumps(d)), ERR)

C = {"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}
def case_doc(case, **kw):
    d = {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[case],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    d.update(kw); return json.dumps(d)
for mutate, label in [
    ({"name":""},'empty name'), ({"name":"a"*33},'long name'), ({"name":"a b"},'space name'),
    ({"name":"a/b"},'slash name'), ({"name":"a","frames":None},'frames null'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{}]},'frame empty'), ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data"}]},'frame missing data'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x","End_Stream":1}]},'End_Stream int'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x","End_Stream":True,"extra":1}]},'extra frame key'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[["a"]]}]},'header pair short'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[["a",1]]}]},'header pair value int'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","headers_kv":{"a":"b"},"data_to_transfered":[["a","b"]]}]},'both header sources'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":1}]},'Type not string'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"bogus"}]},'bogus type'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":-1}]},'negative sleep'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":True}]},'bool sleep'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":1,"End_Stream":True}]},'sleep end_stream'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x"*65537}]},'data too long'),
    ({"name":"a","expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/"}},'expect missing host'),
    ({"name":"a","expect":{"method":"","target":"/","host":"h"}},'empty method'),
    ({"name":"a","expect":{"method":"GE T","target":"/","host":"h"}},'method space'),
    ({"name":"a","expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h","x":1}},'expect extra'),
    ({"name":"a","expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"*8193}},'expect too long'),
    ({"name":"a","expect":{"method":"GET\t","target":"/","host":"h"}},'expect tab'),
    ({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":9223372036854775807}]},'sleep overflow'),
]:
    check('case '+label, run(case_doc(dict(C, **mutate))), ERR)
check('dup case names', run(doc(cases=[C, dict(C)])), ERR)
check('sleep huge ok', len(run(case_doc({"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":9223372036854775807-1}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}))['cases']), 1)
check('seed 64 ok', run(doc(seed='a'*64))['cases'], [])
check('seed 65', run(doc(seed='a'*65)), ERR)
check('seed bad char', run(doc(seed='a$b')), ERR)
check('seed empty ok', run(doc(seed=''))['cases'], [])

def ev_doc(ev, **kw):
    d = {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[C],"events":[ev],"channels":[]}
    d.update(kw); return json.dumps(d)
for ev, label in [
    ({"at":1,"kind":"close","extra":1},'close extra'),
    ({"at":-1,"kind":"close"},'negative at'),
    ({"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[["a"]],"end":True},'fields short'),
    ({"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[["a","b"]],"end":1},'end int'),
    ({"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":-1,"fields":[["a","b"]],"end":True},'stream negative'),
    ({"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":4294967296,"fields":[["a","b"]],"end":True},'stream too big'),
    ({"at":1,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"x"*65537,"end":True},'event data long'),
    ({"at":1,"kind":"bogus"},'bogus kind'),
    ({"at":2**63,"kind":"close"},'at too big'),
]:
    check('event '+label, run(ev_doc(ev)), ERR)
check('event stream max ok', len(run(ev_doc({"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":4294967295,"fields":[["a","b"]],"end":True}))['cases']), 1)
check('event at max ok', len(run(ev_doc({"at":9223372036854775807,"kind":"close"}))['cases']), 1)

def ch_doc(ch, **kw):
    d = {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[C],"events":[],"channels":[ch]}
    d.update(kw); return json.dumps(d)
CH = {"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"x"}]}
for ch, label in [
    ({"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"zz","data":"x"}]},'unknown owner'),
    ({"name":"e","parts":[{"case":1,"data":"x"}]},'owner int'),
    ({"name":"e","parts":[{"data":"x"}]},'part missing case'),
    ({"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"x"*65537}]},'part data long'),
    ({"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"x"},"x"]},'part not object'),
    ({"name":"e"*33,"parts":[]},'channel name long'),
]:
    check('channel '+label, run(ch_doc(ch)), ERR)
check('dup channel names', run(doc(cases=[C], channels=[CH, dict(CH)])), ERR)
check('channel owner null ok', run(ch_doc({"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"x"}]}))['channels'][0]['committed'], [0])

check('definitions 8193', run(doc(definitions=[["d%d"%i,"b'x'"] for i in range(8193)])), ERR)
check('definitions 8192 ok', run(doc(definitions=[["d%d"%i,"b'x'"] for i in range(8192)]))['cases'], [])
check('cases 2001', run(doc(cases=[dict(C, name='c%d'%i) for i in range(2001)])), ERR)
check('cases 2000 ok', len(run(doc(cases=[dict(C, name='c%d'%i) for i in range(2000)]))['cases']), 2000)
check('channels 257', run(doc(channels=[{"name":"h%d"%i,"parts":[]} for i in range(257)])), ERR)
check('channels 256 ok', len(run(doc(channels=[{"name":"h%d"%i,"parts":[]} for i in range(256)]))['channels']), 256)
def pairs_doc(n, blocks=1):
    return doc(cases=[dict(C, frames=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[["a","b"]]*n}]*blocks)])
check('pairs per block 129', run(pairs_doc(129)), ERR)
check('pairs 32768 ok', len(run(pairs_doc(128, 256))['cases']), 1)
check('pairs over budget', run(pairs_doc(128, 257)), ERR)
check('units over budget', run(doc(cases=[dict(C, frames=[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":1}]*25000)],
                                  events=[{"at":0,"kind":"close"}]*25001)), ERR)
check('stdin over budget', json.loads(run_raw(b'{"seed":"'+b'a'*(8*1024*1024)+b'"}').stdout.decode()), ERR)
print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
PYEOF
cd /workspace/project && python3 /workspace/tests/t_input.py 2>&1 | grep -vE "^ok " | head -20
